purpose: Expert calibration rubric for 19 AIA pages; information structure reference only, not GCL brand styling.

dimensions.criteria: Clear claim/question and supporting evidence in comprehensible sequence.
Primary, secondary and tertiary information are distinguishable.
Comparison, process, hierarchy, causality, segmentation or ecosystem is encoded with appropriate diagram grammar.
Chart matches data relationship; labels, units, scales and legends are understandable.
Information is chunked into meaningful groups and remains scannable.
Claims, examples, data and caveats have sufficient context.
Text, contrast, spacing and diagram labels remain readable.
Structure can be generalized without copying AIA brand styling.

review_policy: Do not transfer AIA warm-gold palette or brand appearance into GCL style scoring.
